summary: 32-year-old Colorado Springs man fell ~2,000 ft skiing the north face of Wilson Peak on Saturday afternoon; San Miguel County Sheriff SAR responded, a helicopter inserted the SAR team to the site, packaged the patient and flew back to the Telluride airport where he was transferred to CareFlight for transport to St. Mary's Hospital in Grand Junction; conscious and alert with traumatic injuries; 3-hour mission with 3 sheriff's deputies and 9 SAR members.
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff SAR + CareFlight helicopter
